finding_lineage.disposition: The originally filed BROAD_MATCH and new MappingEvidence defects are already corrected in the selected v3 bytes. This is fresh verification, not a new correction or issue closure.

full_record_assessments.assessment: NITE associates tellurium dioxide with CAS 7446-07-3; PubChem 62638 identifies neutral O2Te. The selected SINGLE_INGREDIENT denotes that input reagent, not the NaOH stock or its dissolved species.

CHEBI:33305 is the broader tellurium molecular entity class. Current NARROW_MATCH is appropriate for the CAS-specific dioxide; it does not make the class exact. The finite captured searches did not identify an exact dioxide term. Current three-row output retains both exact registry identities.

TeO2 is the source formula. Raw TeO is explicitly rejected as an identity alias for this record, preserving the frozen source provenance and avoiding a global formula rewrite. CHEBI:30477 is tellurite O3Te with charge -2, not this dioxide.

The only asserted molecular properties are CAS 7446-07-3 and O2Te, with original database sources and retrieval date preserved. No crystal polymorph, supplier product, hydration, final-stock speciation or physical-role assertion is added.

The pure input reagent has no components, component_assertion, roles, organism-growth, environment, discussion or dataset assertions to approve; absence of those optional assertions is appropriate for this bounded source identity review.

The existing LLM_SUGGESTION entry accurately identifies agent interpretation. Historical creation, grade/enum correction and filed-issue routing events remain unchanged. Old pending-routing prose is within a historical event, while current notes link #1240. No new no-op event is justified.
